· Position relative to SMA100 (102,445 KRW) / SMA200 (101,111 KRW): Below long-term trends, maintaining bearish strength.

· MACD histogram trajectory (83.5308 → -91.5413): Bearish trend continues, post-death cross downward expansion.

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Maintaining wait-and-see due to RSI oversold entry and continued MACD deterioration; need to confirm bounce after testing support at 76,010 KRW.
